name: dsh-im
description: 统一 IM 桥核心：让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 IM 可指挥、可通知、可审批（会话映射 / 命令 / 通知总线 / 审批流 / MockChannel）。
_peerNotes: runtime (lib/) imports only @deepseek-ai/cordis, @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm and @deepseek-ai/schemastery. @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent and @deepseek-ai/dsh-session were declared but never imported by lib/ (only tests reference dsh-agent-loop et al., which do not ship in the bundle), so they were removed to avoid a false incompatibility block on dsh 0.2.x. dsh-llm's range was widened from ^0.1.0-rc.6 to >=0.1.0-rc.6 <0.3.0 because createUserMessage is present and unchanged across 0.1.x/0.2.x (verified against dsh 0.2.0-rc.2).
